summary: Two independent read-only R3 reviews confirm that v40 closes the one-way trust relation, reservation ordering, LP lease digest and observation-manifest evidence model, but the design is not mechanically closed. Required repairs are event-local typed inner artifacts and receipt equality, collision-safe execution identity and output-root containment, continuous worker lock ownership, explicit output-FD write authority, unambiguous immutable reference types, and exact replay transaction, pair-receipt and aggregate-result schemas consistent with pre-execution slot binding.

limitations: Both reviewers were read-only and did not edit files or ledger.
No replay, training, real data, PIT, budget or final-OOS access occurred.
